title: The Golden Bucket
description: The Golden Bucket is a gloriously overengineered bucket that lets you haul around three blocks’ worth of fluid, because apparently one just wasn’t ambitious enough.
body:
## The Golden Bucket

The Golden Bucket is a small, quality-of-life mod that adds exactly one thing to Minecraft: a shiny golden bucket with an unnecessarily impressive sense of ambition.

Unlike a normal bucket that only carries a single block of fluid, this luxurious upgrade can hold up to **three blocks’ worth** at once.
